notes.title: Game release, discount, and new content
notes.notes:
Hello and Happy New Year! The time has come for us to release the game fully. This will come with a small content update and price reduction. Unfortunately due to limited funding and time we will no longer be actively developing this game. We will continue to fix any bugs you encounter. Now let's get into what we have added since the last update.

[h1]Caves[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250805/227e09900949288a29a9a793df0103ee147b8e5b.png[/img]
There is a new type of camp in this world found only in the deepest of crevices. Inside these caves, you may find strange creatures and new items. Watch out for those lurking in the darkest parts of the cave.

[h1]Pumpkins and Cloaks[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250805/238ac130a1a8c8ae2cc995cdf26ca7bc51abde7a.png[/img]
These are our first decorative clothing items that may serve an interesting purpose. The cloak can be found by looting raiders' bodies. The pumpkin can be found in certain crates within caves. While both of these items are equipped they provide you with a stealth bonus. This can be used to sneak through camps. Be careful and don't get too close!

There are some other small changes but we will let you find those on your own. We have also fixed a ton of bugs over the past few months and improved performance. Thank you to everyone playing for your support!

notes.title: Combat improvements, shovels and more
notes.notes:
For this month's update, we have decided to hold back on some of the content that we were going to add. Throughout the month of August, we plan to be working on optimizing our current systems as much as possible. This will make adding content in the future far easier. Now let's get into what exactly has changed in this update.

[h1]Combat Improvements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250805/79911aece17c0303205e22ba7cb9c3f8ef30a511.png[/img]
We have made a number of improvements to melee combat. One of the more notable changes being that we have added a combat tutorial to the start of a new game. Upon picking up the starting axe with this option on, a tutorial enemy will come to fight you and will explain how to fight. Along with the tutorial, we have added a new property to tools/weapons. This is whether a tool/weapon is sharp or blunt. With sharp weapons, you may do more damage however they will not knock back the enemy. With blunt weapons, you will do slightly less damage but you will end up knocking the enemy back.

Some other small improvements include
[list]
[*] Made enemy camps smaller
[*] Increased throwable range
[*] Enemies notice when you throw things near them
[*] Enemies notice when you are shooting at them
[/list]

[h1]Shovels[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250805/09031e778dc697c7c4c0a16f561cbd5d7adbd24a.png[/img]
Shovels have been added as a new tool that is craftable from stone or metal. This tool allows you to dig in the snow. You may find treasure maps while exploring. These will bring you to a special location with something buried beneath the snow. 

[h1]More[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added health indicator for objects when a tool is equipped
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Camera view is now wider
[*] Improved inventory visibility
[*] Increased inventory size by 3 slots
[*] Maps are now consumable like food
[*] Fire damages objects slower
[*] Changed sprites for metal tools/weapons
[*] Adjusted loot spawn
[/list]

notes.title: Road Map and Improved inventory
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Today we thought we would release a smaller update with some bug fixes and improvements.

[h1]Road Map[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250805/0297777a2fa7d3b2b23e2f346b880b6c904478f5.png[/img]
On our [url=https://khiogame.com/]website[/url], you can now view a list of what we plan to work on next. First, we have the early access release which brings you to a page with a list of the recent versions and changes. For a more in-depth list, you can take a look at our [url=https://discord.gg/U5UXpMF]discord[/url]. The next major update will be on August 31st. This will be a small content update. Without giving too much information away this will include a new tutorial, caves, and shovels. After the small content update, we will be focusing on improving optimization and performance as much as possible. Once we have faster and better systems in place we will begin working on adding more content. We plan on adding to the story, expanding the map size, and adding more new and interesting places to explore. Stay tuned for more info.

[h1]Inventory[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250805/5901568f16512882b9f3dfe4e964966a6f319b35.png[/img]
It seems that inventory visibility is becoming more of an issue than we first thought. To improve this we have added a slightly transparent background behind each slot. This should improve the contrast between the slots and different things in the environment. Please let us know if this helps or if there are more specific situations where it is hard to see.

notes.title: UI Improvements, new crafting system and more
notes.notes:
Thank you to all who have purchased the game! After receiving your feedback and watching some of you play we decided a small update was in order.

Before we show all the new stuff in this update, we would like to talk about version numbers. Future updates will delete old saves to prevent any conflicts. This is only temporary and we should be able to keep old saves in the next major update. We are also moving straight to V 0.1.6.0. Our version numbers got a little messed up and this is to ensure saves are being deleted. Now onto the good stuff! 

[h1]UI Improvements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250805/e7a9e15d004cefd4423459ca746121d93e52ff1b.gif[/img]

After watching some of you play we saw how difficult it was to see which objects were interactable. We have now added little blinking squares to objects that you can interact with. Some other notable UI improvements are below.

- Made inventory slots slightly bigger
- Fixed autosave message to appear in the middle of the screen
- Adding status notifications when healing/eating
- Added a settings option to enable censoring of swear words
- Made crates/firepit slots easier to see

[h1]New crafting[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250805/b41c90fb2c01e48adb5417fb4d9219954fa9741d.gif[/img]

We thought that the crafting system could be better than 3 different categories. It seemed as though there was some information overload whenever you would open a new category. The new process is much simpler. Instead of the categories, there is now a new slot where you can place items. When a new item is placed in this slot all of the recipes for that item will show up. We have added what we thought to be the 11 most common recipes as default. The hope is that this will allow you to become more familiar with the recipes. 

[h1]Splints and bandages[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250805/4e428af2cd5913130d82b49a664e1b51aaefdc62.png[/img]

We have changed the way in which splints and bandages are used to heal. These will now be used automatically upon receiving bleed or broken bone status. Icons have been added next to the health bar to indicate that you have a bandage or splint in your inventory. Bandages can still be used to restore 5 health by equipping them in your hot bar (while not bleeding). This should allow for easier healing whilst in combat.

[h1]Final notes[/h1]
A more detailed roadmap for what we plan to do with the game is currently in the works. This will be visible on the changelog portion of our website. An announcement will be made here when that is ready. Several more small updates like this will likely be made before then.

We hope this update enhances the experience for everyone that plays. Please let us know what you think. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/U5UXpMF]discord[/url] to chat with us directly!
